overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Long Municipal Income ETF (TMNL) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on broad credit fixed income. TMNL is an actively managed ETF that invests in long-term, investment grade municipal bonds TMNL was launched on Nov 19, 2025 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
